pageTitle: Novo CRETA | Um SUV tão poderoso quanto você

sections.overview: Full-screen hero banner with vehicle branding, tagline, CTA button, and large car photo

sequences.description: Vehicle logo, model name 'Novo CRETA', tagline 'Sinta o Efeito CRETA', subtitle '#1 em vendas', CTA button 'SOLICITE COTAÇÃO', large hero image of the car, scroll indicator, and brand logos (Bluelink, warranty)

sections.overview: Design section with heading, subtitle, description, navigation tabs (Exterior/Interior), and image carousel with thumbnails

sequences.description: Section heading 'Design', decorative icon, subtitle 'Presença marcante e acabamento premium', description paragraph, and 'Veja também' link tabs for Exterior and Interior
Image carousel with thumbnails grid showing exterior and interior details (wheels, headlights, taillights, grille, dashboard, seats) with navigation dots and prev/next arrows

sections.overview: Performance and safety section with color variant selector, feature carousels for performance and safety, organized in tabbed sub-sections

sequences.description: Section heading 'Desempenho e Segurança', decorative icon, subtitle, description paragraph about power and safety features
Color swatch buttons (6 colors) for selecting vehicle color variant displayed on a large vehicle image
Sub-section 'Desempenho' with image carousel showing engine, transmission, and driving mode features with thumbnail navigation
Sub-section 'Segurança' (Smartsense) with image carousel showing safety features like Forward Collision Avoidance, Blind Spot Detection, Lane Keep Assist etc. with thumbnail navigation

sections.overview: Trunk/cargo space feature highlight with text and video

sequences.description: Heading 'Um espaço que se adapta a você', description about 422L trunk expandable to 1401L, CTA button, and video showing trunk versatility

sections.overview: Technology and connectivity section with accordion-style feature list and corresponding images

sequences.description: Section heading 'Tecnologia e Conectividade', decorative icon, subtitle 'Inovação por onde você olhar', description paragraph

Accordion with image panel on the left - each accordion item shows a tech feature (digital instrument panel, wireless charging, connected car screen, multifunction steering wheel) with description text, and updates the image when expanded

sections.overview: Comfort and convenience features displayed as an image grid gallery with hover-reveal titles

sequences.description: Section heading 'Conforto e conveniência', decorative icon, subtitle 'Pronto para facilitar sua rotina', description paragraph

Grid of feature images (6+ items) showing comfort features like satin chrome finish, shark fin antenna, monitoring camera, anti-pinch windows, retractable cup holder - each with thumbnail image and hover overlay showing title

sections.overview: Accessories section with similar image grid gallery layout

sequences.description: Section heading 'Acessórios', decorative icon, subtitle 'Pensados para todos os momentos da sua vida', description paragraph
Grid of accessory images (6+ items) showing accessories like wheel locks, pet harness, carpet mats, floor lighting, cargo net - each with thumbnail image and hover overlay showing title

sections.overview: Full-width parallax image slider with lifestyle photography

sequences.description: Full-width image slider with 2 lifestyle photos of the Creta in real-world settings (family at home, urban street scene) with pagination dots

sections.overview: Vehicle version comparator with dropdown selectors and specifications table

sequences.description: Section heading 'Compare as versões', decorative icon, subtitle 'Seu Novo CRETA do seu jeito', description paragraph

Vehicle comparator with two vehicle silhouette images, dropdown selectors for versions (e.g. Ultimate), and detailed specifications comparison table with categories like engine, transmission, dimensions, features
